prompt.content:
You are writing brief internal incident summaries for a synthetic enterprise-support dataset used to train and evaluate incident-correlation systems. For each incident in the input JSON array, write a 1-2 sentence SUMMARY an SRE would post in an incident channel: what broke, roughly how, and its user-facing effect. Do not invent additional root causes beyond what's implied by the fields given. Vary tone/length across incidents.

Respond with ONLY a JSON object: {"incidents": [{"i": <int>, "summary": "..."}, ...]} covering every index in the input, in any order.

[{'i': 585, 'component': 'Central Reporting Data Store', 'region': 'global', 'severity': 'major', 'duration_minutes': 180}, {'i': 586, 'component': 'SSO Broker', 'region': 'LATAM', 'severity': 'major', 'duration_minutes': 30}, {'i': 587, 'component': 'Object Storage Service', 'region': 'global', 'severity': 'major', 'duration_minutes': 60}, {'i': 588, 'component': 'Central Message Queue', 'region': 'global', 'severity': 'major', 'duration_minutes': 60}, {'i': 589, 'component': 'SSO Broker (Shared)', 'region': 'ANZ', 'severity': 'critical', 'duration_minutes': 300}, {'i': 590, 'component': 'Container Runtime', 'region': 'ANZ', 'severity': 'critical', 'duration_minutes': 180}, {'i': 591, 'component': 'Query Engine', 'region': 'global', 'severity': 'critical', 'duration_minutes': 180}, {'i': 592, 'component': 'Central Identity Vault', 'region': 'global', 'severity': 'critical', 'duration_minutes': 60}, {'i': 593, 'component': 'Disaster Recovery Orchestrator', 'region': 'global', 'severity': 'critical', 'duration_minutes': 60}, {'i': 594, 'component': 'Alerting Engine', 'region': 'US-West', 'severity': 'major', 'duration_minutes': 60}, {'i': 595, 'component': 'SSO Broker (Shared)', 'region': 'global', 'severity': 'major', 'duration_minutes': 120}, {'i': 596, 'component': 'Social Login Connector', 'region': 'ME', 'severity': 'critical', 'duration_minutes': 120}, {'i': 597, 'component': 'Social Login Connector', 'region': 'APAC', 'severity': 'major', 'duration_minutes': 60}, {'i': 598, 'component': 'Backup & Restore Service', 'region': 'US-East', 'severity': 'major', 'duration_minutes': 30}, {'i': 599, 'component': 'VPN Gateway', 'region': 'global', 'severity': 'critical', 'duration_minutes': 30}]
